{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mining Council''' was the board of the [[Atrakenite Guild of Miners]], and oversaw [[Atrakenite]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] living on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trilos]]. The council consisted of eight members; six were descendents of the original mining families living on Trilos from before the [[Battle of Atraken]], and two from the refugee families that fled [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] following the battle that devastated their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
